title: C¹ target charts through a.e. point with nonzero pushed-forward orientation (parent Steps 1, 3, 6)
statement: Assume (SNA) [the frozen statement of the uncle lemma lpf_simple_nvector_algebra]: for all P, n and v : Fin n → ℝ^P, ‖simpleNVector v‖² = det(⟨v_i, v_j⟩)_{i,j}; and for all P, n, every real n×n matrix B and τ : Fin n → ℝ^P, simpleNVector(i ↦ Σ_j B_ij τ_j) = det(B) • simpleNVector τ; (CRC) [the frozen statement of lpf_countably_rectifiable_c1_cover]: if M ⊆ ℝ^P is countably n-rectifiable, there are C¹ maps Φ_j : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P and open Ω_j ⊆ ℝⁿ (j ∈ ℕ), each Φ_j Lipschitz on Ω_j and c_j-antilipschitz on Ω_j for some c_j > 0, with Hⁿ(M ∖ ⋃_j Φ_j(Ω_j)) = 0; (CCR) [the frozen statement of lpf_chart_chain_rule]: if U ⊆ ℝ^P is open, IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ, f is locally Lipschitz on U, L satisfies the derivative clause, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ is open and Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P is C¹ and antilipschitz on Ω, then for Lⁿ-a.e. w ∈ Ω ∩ Φ⁻¹(M): HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ (Φ w) (range DΦ(w)), and f∘Φ has Fréchet derivative L(Φ(w))∘DΦ(w) at w; and (LCIP) [the frozen statement of lpf_lipschitz_c1_immersion_pieces]: if Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ is open and u : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q is locally Lipschitz on Ω, there are C¹ maps G_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q, open O_k ⊆ ℝⁿ with G_k antilipschitz on O_k, and pairwise disjoint Borel E_k ⊆ O_k ∩ Ω (k ∈ ℕ), such that u(w) = G_k(w) and u has Fréchet derivative DG_k(w) at w for every w ∈ E_k, and Lⁿ-a.e. w ∈ Ω at which u has an injective Fréchet derivative lies in ⋃_k E_k. Let P, Q, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, (M, θ, ξ) with IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ, f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q locally Lipschitz on U, and L : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) satisfying the derivative clause. Then there are C¹ maps G_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q and open sets O_k ⊆ ℝⁿ (k ∈ ℕ), each G_k c_k-antilipschitz on O_k for some c_k > 0, with the following property. For Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x with L(x)_#ξ(x) ≠ 0 there are k ∈ ℕ, w ∈ O_k with G_k(w) = f(x), and an orthonormal σ : Fin n → ℝ^Q with span(range σ) = range DG_k(w), such that L(x)_#ξ(x) = ‖L(x)_#ξ(x)‖ • simpleNVector σ or L(x)_#ξ(x) = −(‖L(x)_#ξ(x)‖ • simpleNVector σ).
